response.sql: WITH fee_orders AS (SELECT o.orderbase, f.feerate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL), channel_averages AS (SELECT orderbase, AVG(feerate) as avg_rate FROM fee_orders GROUP BY orderbase), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(feerate) as bench_rate FROM fee_orders), above_benchmark AS (SELECT ca.avg_rate, ca.avg_rate - b.bench_rate as excess FROM channel_averages ca CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE ca.avg_rate > b.bench_rate) SELECT AVG(avg_rate) as mean_avg_rate, AVG(excess) as mean_excess FROM above_benchmark
